name: Warrick County, IN
findings: Warrick County has 203 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Warrick County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do religious organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 22 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
